title: atip/1 error registry entry
description: One row of a tool's error registry (spec section 7.3). The exit of an error is fixed here, never at the call site. Closed for tools of the current minor; callers read it open (spec 15.8).

exit.description: 1: the command ran and the answer is negative or incomplete. 2: refused before doing it. Signal exits (128+n) are not registry entries.

retryable.description: true only when repeating the same invocation unchanged can succeed.

fix.description: What the caller does next, in one or two sentences; a runnable command when there is one.

reasons.description: The situations under this code that need different next actions (spec 7.6). Each reason is unique within the code (spec 10.13 rule 14) and shares the code's exit and retryable.

fix.description: What the caller does next in this situation, in one or two sentences; a runnable command when there is one.
